header.one_line: Uttarakhand, across the Kumaon hills from Kathgodam through Almora and Bageshwar, then over Kalamuni Top to Munsiyari

rules.title: Binsar sanctuary: two-wheelers stop at the check post
rules.detail: An operator guide, citing the state tourism corporation, says two-wheelers may not pass the forest check post. Gate hours are 07:00 to 18:00 in summer, 08:00 to 17:00 in winter.

source.title: Binsar Uttarakhand Travel Guide: Places, Fees & Best Time

rules.title: Binsar sanctuary: entry fee paid at the gate
rules.detail: A fee per person and per vehicle is paid at the single forest gate. No current official tariff was found, so amounts are left out.

source.title: Binsar Uttarakhand Travel Guide: Places, Fees & Best Time

rules.title: Uttarakhand green cess: two-wheelers exempt
rules.detail: Vehicles from other states pay a green cess on entry, read by number-plate cameras at the border. Two-wheelers, electric and gas vehicles are exempt. Official order not found.

source.title: Uttarakhand Begins Green Cess Collection From Out-of-State Vehicles, Faces Initial Technical Glitches

history.change: Cess announced, with two-wheelers among the exempt classes.

season.note: No road on this route closes for a season; the Thal to Munsiyari road is cut by landslides in the monsoon and by snow at Kalamuni in winter.

gaps: Usual number of days: no source found.
Kalamuni Top altitude is converted from the 9,500 feet given by an operator blog; no official figure found.
No road number found for the Bageshwar to Thal to Munsiyari stretch, and no source found for which office announces its status.
The Binsar two-wheeler rule comes from an operator page that cites the state tourism corporation's booking page; that page was not opened and no forest department order was found.
No source found on whether any permit applies at or beyond Munsiyari.
Kausani, Nainital and Almora: no local vehicle rules or entry taxes were researched.
Uttarakhand green cess: the exemption for two-wheelers is reported by two news outlets; no Transport Department order or official page was found.
No rider videos collected; the search budget ran out before this route.
